decisions.reason: The compact inverse image is intrinsically compact, whereas the local-finiteness neighbourhoods are ambient opens. The argument is valid by the proved ambient compactness criterion, but def-compact-space expressly requires its citation. Added lem-compactness-of-a-subspace-is-ambient to deps and at the finite-subcover use; finite choice only, with no AC assumption.

The extension remark lacked the necessary specified splitting of the lower truncation. The given A^1 example cannot be split since its zero-section degeneracy is not an open-and-closed summand. Deligne III (6.2.3)-(6.2.4), printed pp.19-20, explicitly requires split lower data and gives uniqueness up to unique data-preserving isomorphism. Repaired only the remark; Definition unchanged, and the hyperresolution induction already supplies the required splitting.

F1 incorrectly applied integral projectivity to an arbitrary smooth ambient scheme; A^2 is a counterexample. Qualified only that sentence to X=P^N and applied the integral-projective blowup lemma inductively. The actual step 1.1 already starts in P^N, with proper regular centers and nonzero finite-type ideals; matching limits, split induction and relative refinement remain valid. Statement and all proved scope are unchanged.

The cited descent Statement requires bounded constructible F in D^b_c(X;k), not arbitrary bounded-below coefficients. Corrected F2 to this exact field-coefficient domain and cochain lower bound. Every actual descent use in steps 1.1, 3.1 and 3.2 is Q_Y concentrated in degree zero, so the constructed MHS, functoriality and class-map claims are unchanged; no extension theorem is needed.

The rejection considers only the logarithmic supplier Statement. Its current proof step 8.1 explicitly extends the actual image formula to arbitrary smooth projective compactifications using F7 SNC domination and lem-smooth-projective-modification-preserves-open-cohomology-images. That lemma proves j* T=(j-prime)* by compact-support excision and Poincare duality (steps 1.2-5.1), then arbitrary-boundary invariance in 6.1. Thus F1 faithfully invokes an already proved clause. Strictness gives g*(W_n)=im(g*) because W_n of the proper target is full, and the lower source bound makes the common image pure of weight n. No item edit.

Although the proper-weights Statement abbreviates the construction, its proof step 1.1 explicitly establishes E2 degeneration and Gr^W_q H^n=E2^(n-q,q) for the chosen smooth-projective proper hypercover, using the declared simplicial-weights lemma part (ii). The reduced normalization nerve here satisfies those same hypotheses: P^1 plus finitely many reduced points, proper surjective matching maps, and split degeneracies. Directly evaluating all seven degree-two components gives ker(delta^1)=Q(0,1,-1), while delta^0=0 and H^1(P^1)=0. The supplied weight identification gives only weight zero in H^1; negative weights vanish by first-quadrant q>=0. No unsupported inference from the upper bound alone is used and no item edit is needed.
